notes.subject: ol
notes.rationale: Sapela sufiks -מו i tok wanem: ol man i gat mak long en; Tok Pisin i nidim ol.

notes.subject: ol tupela han bilong yu
notes.rationale: ידיך i dualis — tupela han, i no planti han.

notes.subject: תבאמו ותטעמו
notes.rationale: Tupela tok i klostu wankain long nois (-אמו); planti tok i lus long Tok Pisin.

translation: Yahwe, yu bai rausim ol i kam insait, na yu planim ol long maunten bilong samting yu givim long ol bilong ganim, long ples we yu wokim bilong yu stap long en, Yahwe; long holi ples, Adonai, we ol tupela han bilong yu i bin strongim.

tokens.gloss: yu bai rausim ol i kam insait
